info.name: LegalMind API — Frontend Integration
info.description: Complete frontend collection for all 46 public backend endpoints. Import it with a LegalMind Frontend environment. Login stores the bearer access token automatically; refresh cookies remain HTTP-only in Postman's cookie jar. Registration is JSON-only; only the dedicated avatar endpoint uses multipart/form-data. Payment endpoints require Stripe test keys configured in the backend.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Public requests explicitly disable the collection's bearer token. Login, refresh, and reset automatically update the access token.

request.description: Creates an account (201). Password: 8–128 characters containing lower-case, upper-case, and a digit. Email verification is required before login.
Verifies the emailed token.
Generic success response; limited to 5 requests/hour.
Returns access token and public user, and sets the HTTP-only refresh cookie. The test script captures the access token.
Rotates the refresh-token cookie and returns a new access token. For body-based testing use { "refreshToken": "{{refresh_token}}" }.
Bearer auth. Returns the public user.
Revokes this refresh-token session and clears the cookie (204).
Bearer auth. Revokes all refresh sessions for the current user (204).
Requests a reset email; generic response prevents account enumeration.
Uses the emailed reset token, creates a new session, and captures its access token.

item.name: User profile, avatar & bookmarks
item.description: All requests require bearer authentication. Registration stays application/json. Only Upload avatar uses multipart/form-data. Avatar bytes are held in memory and uploaded to Cloudflare R2; they are never written to backend local disk.

request.description: REPLACE old PATCH /api/users/profile with PATCH /api/v1/users/profile. Send JSON and at least one field. Allowed fields: fullName, officeName, phone, barAssociationNumber, teamSize. The schema is strict: role, email, isActive, isEmailVerified, organizationId, avatarUrl, and unknown fields are rejected. Success: 200 { message, user }. The returned user is the same public-user shape used by auth and includes avatarUrl (string or null).

REPLACE old POST /api/users/profile/avatar with POST /api/v1/users/profile/avatar. This dedicated request is the ONLY user/auth flow that uses multipart/form-data; registration remains JSON-only and must not contain lawyerIdDocument. Select one file in the avatar field. Accepted: JPEG, PNG, or WebP; maximum 2 MB. MIME type and file signature are validated. The backend streams the in-memory file to Cloudflare R2 and stores the public URL; no local upload directory is used. Do not manually set Content-Type because Postman/browser must add the multipart boundary. Success: 200 { message, user }, read user.avatarUrl and replace the displayed avatar.

REPLACE old POST /api/blogs/:blogId/bookmark with POST /api/v1/blogs/:blogId/bookmark. Toggles the authenticated user's bookmark for an existing published blog. Success: 200 { bookmarked: boolean, action: 'added' | 'removed' }. Update local state from bookmarked and fetch the bookmark list when bookmark_id is needed. Blog CRUD and comment CRUD are now available in their dedicated Postman folders.

exec: if (first && first.bookmark_id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('bookmark_id', first.bookmark_id); if (pm.environment.name) pm.environment.set('bookmark_id', first.bookmark_id); }
if (first && first.blog_id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('blog_id', first.blog_id); if (pm.environment.name) pm.environment.set('blog_id', first.blog_id); }

request.description: REPLACE old GET /api/users/me/bookmarks with GET /api/v1/users/me/bookmarks. Query: page >= 1, limit 1-50. Success: 200 { bookmarks, pagination }. Each item has bookmark_id, blog_id, created_at, and a nested published blog projection. The script captures bookmark_id and blog_id from the first item.

REPLACE old DELETE /api/users/me/bookmarks/:bookmarkId with DELETE /api/v1/users/me/bookmarks/:bookmarkId. Deletes only a bookmark owned by the authenticated user and decrements its blog count. Success is 204 No Content: frontend code must not parse JSON.
Bearer auth. Stateless RAG query; it is not stored in a conversation. query: 3–2000 chars, top_k: 1–50 and law_category is optional.

item.name: Conversations
item.description: Every endpoint requires bearer auth and uses current user/organization ownership. Create a conversation first to fill conversation_id.

request.description: Creates a conversation (201) and saves its ID. Both fields are optional; title is 1–160 characters.
Lists newest-first. limit: 1–50; status: active|archived; cursor is an optional opaque pagination cursor.
Returns one owned conversation.
Lists messages oldest-first. limit: 1–100; use next_cursor to paginate.
Creates a saved user/assistant message pair (201). idempotency_key must be a UUID. Reuse it only to retry exactly the same message; rate limited to 20/minute.
Supply at least one of title or status; valid status is active|archived.
Soft-deletes the owned conversation (204).

item.name: Blogs
item.description: Published browsing is public. Create/my/update/delete require bearer auth and update/delete enforce author ownership. Status moderation requires an admin token.

exec: if (id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('blog_id', id); if (pm.environment.name) pm.environment.set('blog_id', id); }

request.description: REPLACE GET /api/blogs with GET /api/v1/blogs. Public. Query: page>=1, limit 1-50, sort newest|popular, optional search, category, comma-separated tags. Returns { blogs, pagination }; saves the first blog_id.
REPLACE GET /api/blogs/categories. Returns { categories: [{ value, label }] }. Values are the exact category strings accepted by create/update.
REPLACE GET /api/blogs/popular. Public; limit 1-50. Returns published blogs ordered by views.
REPLACE GET /api/blogs/trending. Public; returns most-viewed blogs published in the last seven days.
REPLACE GET /api/blogs/:id. Public published detail and increments views. Frontend may attach bearer auth to receive isBookmarked and let an author view their own unpublished post.

request.description: REPLACE POST /api/blogs. Bearer auth. Strict JSON; title 5-200, content 20-100000, excerpt <=500, coverImage URL or empty, <=10 tags, status draft|pending|published. Returns 201 { message, blog } and saves blog_id.

Bearer auth. Upload a blog cover image to Cloudflare R2. Select one file in the image field. Accepted: JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF; maximum 5 MB. MIME type is validated. The backend streams the in-memory file to R2 and returns the public URL. Do not manually set Content-Type because Postman/browser must add the multipart boundary. Success: 201 { message, image: { url, key } }. Use the returned URL for the coverImage field when creating or updating a blog.

request.description: REPLACE GET /api/blogs/me/my-blogs. Bearer auth. Returns all statuses owned by the current user with pagination.
REPLACE PUT /api/blogs/:id. Bearer auth; author only. Send at least one create-blog field. Returns { message, blog }. A non-author receives 403.
REPLACE DELETE /api/blogs/:id. Author or admin only. Also removes the blog's bookmarks and comments. Returns 204 No Content; do not parse JSON.
REPLACE PATCH /api/blogs/:id/status. Admin bearer token required. status: draft|pending|published|rejected; rejectionReason is required for rejected. Normal frontend lawyer accounts receive 403.

request.description: REPLACE POST /api/blogs/:blogId/comments. Bearer auth; published blogs only. content is 1-1000 characters. Returns 201 { message, comment } and saves comment_id.

REPLACE DELETE /api/comments/:id. Author or admin only. Returns 204 No Content; do not parse JSON.

item.name: Payments
item.description: Stripe checkout and payment history. All requests require bearer auth. Create a checkout session, complete payment in browser with test card 4242 4242 4242 4242, then check status and history.

exec: console.log('Open this URL in a browser to complete payment.');

request.description: Bearer auth. Creates a Stripe Checkout Session and returns { sessionId, url }. Open the URL in a browser to complete payment with a test card (4242 4242 4242 4242). Rate limited to 20 requests per 15 minutes. The script captures stripe_session_id and stripe_checkout_url.

query.description: Stripe Checkout Session ID (captured from create checkout session)

request.description: Bearer auth. Returns Stripe session payment_status and local DB status. Use after completing payment in the browser to verify the webhook processed the payment.
Bearer auth. Returns paginated payment history for the current user. Each item includes id, plan_id, amount, currency, status, description, stripe_session_id, and created_at.
